It also says `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex layer, which is used by multithreaded callers when enabled. || QUOTE: "The library creates no threads." and "Enabling `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` adds: Global mutexes: `mbedtls_threading_key_slot_mutex`...
